Population increased in East Hampshire

The estimated population of East Hampshire in 2024 was 129,975 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that East Hampshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of East Hampshire increased by 3%.

Over this slightly longer period, East Hampshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of East Hampshire

The average (median) age rose to 47 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of East Hampshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
East Hampshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, East Hampshire's population of 129,975 usual residents was made up of:

  • 22,404 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.2%)
  • 75,878 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.4%)
  • 31,693 people aged 65 years and over, (24.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, East Hampshire has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In East Hampshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in East Hampshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for East Hampshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 352 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 989 births and 1,341 deaths in East Hampshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,008 (0.8%). There were 7,934 people entering the area and 6,926 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in East Hampshire's population of 365 (0.3%) as a result of 731 people entering the area and 366 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for East Hampshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of East Hampshire in mid-2023 is 128,945.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 388 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 117 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 505 people.
